sections.title: Building software from interface to backend and production.
sections.body:
I’m a software engineer whose professional work started primarily in mobile development and expanded into backend and full-stack product development. I’ve worked on production payment apps, operational systems, backend APIs, web applications, databases, device integrations, deployment, and release workflows.

I prefer owning real product problems end-to-end: understanding the flow, building the feature, integrating services, handling edge cases, shipping it, and fixing what happens in production.

projects.title: PUAS Hub
projects.subtitle: PPOB & Digital Product Mobile Application
projects.summary: Built from the ground up through final delivery, covering complete digital payment flows, thermal printer integration, and real-time transaction state handling.
projects.cover_alt_text: PUAS Hub transaction history and digital product purchase screens

sections.title: Context
sections.body_md: PUAS Hub is an operational agent and merchant application enabling daily digital transactions such as phone credit (pulsa), data packages, electricity tokens, e-wallet top-ups, and utility bill payments. Agents rely on the app on low to mid-tier mobile hardware, frequently connecting to external Bluetooth thermal printers to issue paper receipts directly to end customers.

sections.title: My Role
sections.body_md: I owned the Flutter application from initial architecture through final delivery. This included building responsive UI layouts, designing robust state management using BLoC, integrating backend REST endpoints, handling hardware connectivity with thermal receipt printers, and diagnosing transaction status discrepancies.

sections.title: What I Built
sections.body_md:
- Complete digital product catalog with instant category filtering and real-time operator prefix detection.
- Transaction checkout pipeline with client-side balance validation, confirmation bottom sheets, and PIN authentication.
- Bluetooth ESC/POS receipt generation engine supporting custom store headers, itemized breakdowns, and footer notes.
- Resilient transaction history module with status badges (Success, Pending, Failed) and search by invoice ID.
- Network error recovery and automatic token refresh interceptors preventing session drops during transactions.

sections.title: Engineering Decisions
sections.body_md:
- **Predictable Transaction State**: Adopted BLoC to enforce explicit transitions between `Processing`, `PendingVerification`, `Success`, and `Failed`. This completely eliminated duplicate balance deductions caused by impatient repeated taps.
- **Hardware Abstraction Layer**: Built a unified printer service that buffers character sequences and wraps ESC/POS command formatting, allowing different 58mm printer models to be used without vendor-specific code patches.
- **Optimized List Rendering**: Implemented sliver-based virtualized lists for transaction logs and product grids to preserve 60fps scrolling on budget Android devices.

sections.title: Integrations
sections.body_md:
- REST API with HMAC request signing and Bearer token lifecycle.
- Bluetooth SPP (Serial Port Profile) thermal receipt printers.
- Native Android permissions and background connection management.

sections.title: Challenges & Solutions
sections.body_md: Digital product aggregators occasionally return indeterminate statuses while billing provider queues clear. Rather than treating slow responses as timeouts or failures, I designed an active polling and fallback state with a clear countdown and retry mechanism, preventing duplicate user orders and merchant panic.

sections.title: Result
sections.body_md:
- Delivered the complete application to production within the client engagement timeline.
- Verified stable receipt printing and transaction completion across multiple Android device form factors.
- Formed the reusable foundational mobile codebase for subsequent operational tool rollouts.

sections.title: Technology Stack
sections.body_md: Flutter, Dart, BLoC State Management, Dio, REST API, ESC/POS Bluetooth Printer Protocol.

projects.title: Member App Ecosystem
projects.subtitle: Multi-Brand White-Label Mobile Architecture
projects.summary: Scaled a modular mobile architecture supporting multiple financial and membership brands with QRIS payments, virtual cards, PPOB, and continuous store releases.
projects.cover_alt_text: Multi-tenant member app ecosystem showcasing virtual card and payment interfaces across brands

sections.title: Context
sections.body_md: Commercial enterprise clients required their own branded member and payment applications without maintaining disjointed codebases. The ecosystem required dynamic theming, virtual card generation, standard national QR payments (QRIS), merchant point-of-sale catalog browsing, and seamless submission across both Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

sections.title: My Role
sections.body_md: As a core mobile engineer on the team, I engineered configurable frontend components, integrated QRIS scanning and rendering pipelines, implemented virtual member card modules, and managed app deployment configurations for client brand releases.

sections.title: What I Built
sections.body_md:
- Dynamic tenant theme injector pulling brand color schemes, typography, and logo assets at runtime.
- Integrated camera QR scanner with parsing for standard Indonesian QRIS transaction payload strings.
- Virtual membership card visual component with barcode rendering, tap-to-copy card numbers, and security masking.
- In-app PPOB and digital voucher purchase flows directly connected to tenant wallet balance.
- Store build pipeline configurations using EAS for parallel client production distribution.

sections.title: Engineering Decisions
sections.body_md:
- **Single Codebase, Multiple Brand Profiles**: Structured build configuration presets separating bundle identifiers, assets, and API base targets rather than maintaining distinct branches.
- **Lightweight State via Zustand**: Replaced heavy legacy boilerplate with Zustand slices for session auth, member tier caching, and shopping cart persistence.
- **Defensive Error Boundaries**: Wrapped high-risk device capabilities (camera, NFC, hardware storage) in contextual fallback boundaries so unexpected hardware permission denials do not crash the application.

sections.title: Result
sections.body_md:
- Successfully contributed to active production deployments across 15+ client applications on Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
- Drastically reduced delivery time when bootstrapping and skinning newly onboarded commercial clients.

projects.title: Lembar
projects.subtitle: Modern Document & Workflow Platform
projects.summary: Full-stack product engineering showcasing strict schema migrations, high-throughput Fastify API design, Drizzle ORM typing, and a responsive Next.js web application.
projects.cover_alt_text: Lembar product dashboard view with workflow pipeline and document status trackers

sections.title: Context
sections.body_md: Lembar was designed as a modern operational system for managing collaborative document lifecycles, structured approval queues, and team revision workflows. It serves as a flagship demonstration of clean separation between a high-efficiency backend API and an editorial frontend interface.

sections.title: My Role
sections.body_md: I designed and developed both repositories from inception: Frontend-Lembar (Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind) and Backend-Lembar (Fastify, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM). I authored the database schema, migration history, API contracts, and client integration services.

sections.title: Engineering Decisions
sections.body_md:
- **Fastify for Low Overhead**: Selected Fastify for its high-performance asynchronous request pipeline and native schema compilation.
- **Type-safe Database Layer**: Used Drizzle ORM to maintain compile-time type safety from SQL schemas directly into API response contracts, eliminating runtime type drift.
- **Contract-first API Specifications**: Generated comprehensive OpenAPI schemas, enabling frontend consumers to generate typed HTTP clients automatically.

sections.title: Result
sections.body_md:
- Proven end-to-end full-stack architecture running with strict TypeScript verification across frontend and backend.
- Clean database migrations and seed tooling allowing effortless local setup and automated integration test runs.

projects.title: CRM Platform
projects.subtitle: Enterprise Sales & Lead Management System
projects.summary: Engineered an end-to-end business operations portal combining NestJS backend services, Supabase PostgreSQL, JWT role access control, and a Next.js administrative dashboard.
projects.cover_alt_text: CRM Platform sales pipeline dashboard and lead tracking interface

sections.title: Context
sections.body_md: A centralized sales and customer operations application built to track leads through customizable pipeline stages, manage client communications, maintain activity audit histories, and enforce strict role-based access control across sales agents and managers.

sections.title: Engineering Decisions
sections.body_md:
- **NestJS Modular Architecture**: Enforced modular domain separation (Auth, Leads, Pipeline, Contacts, Audits) allowing independent testing of services and controllers.
- **JWT & Role Guards**: Implemented hierarchical route guards ensuring sales representatives only mutate their assigned pipeline records while administrators maintain organizational oversight.
- **Supabase PostgreSQL & Security**: Utilized managed PostgreSQL with Row Level Security policies complementing application-level middleware.

projects.title: Explore Bojonegoro
projects.subtitle: Native Android Regional Tourism Guide
projects.summary: Native Android application showcasing early foundation in Kotlin, Coroutines, Retrofit networking, interactive map routing, and local cache synchronization.
projects.cover_alt_text: Explore Bojonegoro mobile app screens showcasing destination guides and interactive map navigation

sections.title: Context
sections.body_md: A mobile exploration application built to help tourists discover regional destinations, historical landmarks, culinary spots, and cultural events across Bojonegoro, featuring GPS navigation, weather forecasts, and offline bookmarks.

sections.title: Engineering Decisions
sections.body_md:
- **MVVM with Clean Separation**: Decoupled View layer from Business Logic using Android ViewModel, StateFlow, and Coroutine dispatchers for asynchronous background fetching.
- **Offline Caching**: Stored destination metadata locally in SQLite/Room to ensure travelers with intermittent mobile coverage could still access directions and landmark descriptions.
